newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina starts up 60,000 bpd Balipapan refinery.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina starts up 60,000 bpd Balipapan refinery.

text.p: Indonesian state oil company Pertamina said on Monday it has started up its new 60,000 barrels- per-day (bpd) Balikpapan refinery.
"We have started up the 60,000 bpd capacity refinery with operations at around 50 percent at the moment," the official, who declined to be identified, told Reuters.
"The start-up began early last week. All units are running okay so far. The capacity of the refinery can be increased to 65,000 bpd in future," he said.
The official said Pertamina has stopped operating its old 50,000 bpd capacity in Balikpapan.
He said the other refinery in Balikpapan, which has a capacity of 200,000 bpd, was also running well.
